# Register reference {#registers}

This appendix lists the registers of LiteI2C: the speed register of the PHY and the
registers of the register master. It is generated from the register definitions of the
gateware, elaborated on a reference design for the Arty A7 platform without running an
FPGA toolchain. Offsets are in bytes from the base of the bank; the base address depends
on the SoC and is in the `csr.csv` of a build.

| Configuration | Target and options |
|------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|
| `arty_reference` | `digilent_arty` `add_i2c_master()` `with_irq=True` `pads=pmodb:0,1` |

Access is `rw` for a register written by software (`CSRStorage`, or a `CSRStatus` that
software also writes, such as event pending bits cleared by writing 1), `ro` for a status
(`CSRStatus`) and `wo` for a write-only strobe (`CSR`). The reset value of a `CSRStorage`
register ends its description. A register wider than 32 bits takes several
32-bit words of the bus, most significant word first. Software uses these names through the `csr.h` or `csr.csv` of the build
([Bare-metal software](#integ-baremetal)).

## LiteI2C {#reg-i2cmaster}

Defined by `LiteI2C` (`litei2c/__init__.py`).

The PHY (`LiteI2CPHYCore`, `litei2c/phy/generic.py`) holds `phy_speed_mode`; the register
master (`LiteI2CMaster`, `litei2c/core/master.py`) holds the other registers. The
`master_ev_*` registers exist only with `with_irq=True`, which `add_i2c_master` sets when
the CPU has an interrupt of the same name; with `with_master=False` the bank holds
`phy_speed_mode` only. The fields of `master_status` other than `tx_ready` and `rx_ready`
describe the head of the RX FIFO: they are valid only while `rx_ready` is 1. The bank takes
the name given to `add_i2c_master`, `i2cmaster` by default ([The register master](#master)).

Bank `i2cmaster`.

| Register | Offset | Bits | Access | Description |
|----------------------------|-------------|--------|---------|----------------------------------------|
| `phy_speed_mode` | `0x0000` | 2 | rw | I2C speed mode (0: 100 kHz Standard-mode, 1: 400 kHz Fast-mode, 2: 1 MHz Fast-mode Plus, 3: reserved, 100 kHz), applied while ``active`` is 0. Reset `0x0`. |
| `master_active` | `0x0004` | 1 | rw | 1: request the bus for the register master (its crossbar port) and enable the PHY. Keep it at 1 for the whole transaction, chunks included. Reset `0x0`. |
| `master_settings` | `0x0008` | 17 | rw | I2C transfer settings Reset `0x0`. |
| `master_addr` | `0x000c` | 7 | rw | 7-bit address of the target, sent with the next element written to `master_rxtx`. Reset `0x0`. |
| `master_rxtx` | `0x0010` | 32 | rw | Read/write register (a read has a side effect: it pops the RX FIFO). Write: push one element into the TX FIFO, with up to 4 data bytes (the first byte on the bus in the most significant byte used) and the current `master_settings` and `master_addr`; check `tx_ready` first. Read: pop one status element from the RX FIFO; the last byte received is in bits 7:0. |
| `master_status` | `0x0014` | 18 | ro | See the fields below. |
| `master_ev_` `status` | `0x0018` | 1 | ro | This register contains the current raw level of the event trigger. Writes to this register have no effect. |
| `master_ev_` `pending` | `0x001c` | 1 | rw | When an event occurs, the corresponding bit will be set in this register. To clear the Event, set the corresponding bit in this register. |
| `master_ev_` `enable` | `0x0020` | 1 | rw | This register enables the corresponding events. Write a ``0`` to this register to disable individual events. Reset `0x0`. |

Fields of `master_settings`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `len_tx` | 2:0 | I2C tx Xfer length (in bytes). Set to a value greater than 4 to announce more data has to be transmitted. |
| `len_rx` | 10:8 | I2C rx Xfer length (in bytes). Set to a value greater than 4 to announce more data has to be received. |
| `recover` | 16 | I2C recover bus. If set, the I2C bus will be recovered. |

Fields of `master_status`:

| Field | Bits | Description |
|------------------------|---------|------------------------------------------------------|
| `tx_ready` | 0 | TX FIFO is not full. |
| `rx_ready` | 1 | RX FIFO is not empty. |
| `nack` | 8 | Transfer not acknowledged (address or data NACK), also set with bus_error. |
| `bus_error` | 9 | I2C bus error on transfer. |
| `tx_unfinished` | 16 | Another tx transfer is expected. |
| `rx_unfinished` | 17 | Another rx transfer is expected. |
